mode: Selected existing generated photographic artwork and composed typography and style attributes separately. No new photograph generated.
comparisonPolicy: Program: only badge 1 and badge 2 fills/radii change to make styles follow categories. Products: only drawing-kit price font-family and font-style change, retaining 26-unit size/weight/anchors. Booking: only noninteractive status surface opacity and label fill change. All wording, coordinates, sizes, other styles, photographs/crops, paper/device and lighting remain fixed.

verification.textBounds: within paper surface, including nested copy-block transforms
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared similarity intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: All six saved browser PNGs visually inspected. Text fits each paper or phone surface and there is no horizontal overflow. Pixel checks isolate declared style-change regions; DOM comparisons check unchanged copy, positions, sizes, photos/crops and unrelated styles. Standalone artwork and article-renderer markup are checked separately.

limitations: No reader study, measured selection or comprehension improvement, physical print trial, whole-artifact accessibility conformance, assistive-technology audit or full production-route result. The booking example is a static mockup and does not implement actions or live status updates.
